candidates.change_summary: Change the final returned boolean from true to false.
Invert the success check of the external call so the function returns true only if the internal call failed (without reverting).
Move the final return to inside the loop so the function returns after the first successful call, potentially changing returned value for multi-recipient calls.
Replace the hardcoded multiplier 1e18 with 1 (removes scaling), changing amounts sent and thus observable behavior.
Change the sender check to require msg.sender equals caddress instead of from, altering who can call transfer and thus observed outcomes.
Remove the require(_tos.length > 0) guard so calls with empty arrays proceed (changing observable behavior when empty arrays are passed).
Change multiplication order to v[i] + 1000000000000000000 (adds constant instead of scaling), modifying amounts and observable behavior.
